summary: Autonomous research pass refining a backlog item's spec.
description: One agent round that investigates the item's kind, deliverable, prior workshop history and attached context, and refines the spec/research toward readiness. Mirrors internal/backlog/research.go: it produces a workshop round envelope and either continues (another round is warranted), completes (the spec is ready for synthesis/finalize), or blocks.

inputs.name: OPERATOR_NOTE
inputs.description: Optional operator guidance for this research round.

inputs.name: USER_PROMPT
inputs.description: The operator's research prompt/instruction driving this refinement pass (legacy research request text).

inputs.name: CONTEXT_PATHS
inputs.description: Repository paths/files the operator attached as research context, one per line.

inputs.name: CONTEXT_TARGETS
inputs.description: Named targets (scenarios, resources, components) the operator scoped the research to, one per line.

inputs.name: CONTEXT_REQUIREMENTS
inputs.description: Explicit requirements or acceptance notes the operator attached to fold into the spec.

inputs.name: GAP_REPORT
inputs.description: A prior readiness/gap report identifying what the spec still lacks, to steer this round.

fields.name: handoff
fields.description: Structured handoff: summary, blockers, next step, changed files, tests. The single artifact the next round consumes and the classifier derives progress from.

fields.name: progress
fields.description: Routing signal derived from the handoff: continue (another round is warranted), complete (the operation's unit of work is done), or blocked (needs operator attention).

fields.name: decisions
fields.description: The lettered-option decisions this round surfaces for the operator, each an object {id, topic, text, context?, options:[{key, label, rationale, recommended?}]}. An empty array when the round surfaces no new decisions; the operator answers each by selecting an option key or providing freeform.

fields.name: self_assessment
fields.description: The agent's 5-dimension readiness self-assessment {problem_clarity, scope_defined, approach_solid, testable, risk_awareness}, each an integer 0-3. An INPUT to the workshop service's readiness computation (which applies round-count boosts), not the final readiness verdict.

outcomes.name: completed
outcomes.description: The operation's unit of work finished; the workflow advances (e.g. opens review).

outcomes.name: continue
outcomes.description: Another round of the same operation is warranted; the loop continues.

outcomes.name: blocked
outcomes.description: Progress is blocked; the round parks for operator attention.

outcomes.name: needs-attention
outcomes.description: The classifier could not derive an honest outcome; the round abstains to operator attention.
